gen-gf-judson-gf-cascadia-mono: Fine-haired and bookish, Judson sits over Cascadia Mono, a sans-serif whose curves and stems run in lockstep, each letter a pin. Judson's hairlines nearly vanish in dim light, while the oversized lowercase stays inviting.
gen-gf-judson-gf-julius-sans-one: Wide gaps and a flat gray hum of line give the body its read, against Judson's heavy-bulging, tapering curves. Julius Sans One would make extended reading feel light, its curves left open at the ends.
gen-gf-judson-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa draws with a rolling-ball pen's single width, curves wide open. Judson does lopsided drama best, stout stems against hairlines, while the sans keeps every curve distinct beside a big x-height.
gen-gf-judson-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga is flat, single-weight and generously tracked, each word opened up. Shrink Judson and its hairlines nearly vanish beside the dark stems, a loss this sans-serif body never risks.
gen-gf-judson-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega looks drawn with a single nib, its body height nearly matching the capitals and every c gaping. Judson's swelling strokes against that constant sans line are the real draw.
gen-gf-judson-gf-lexend-peta: Approachable and unstressed, Lexend Peta curves without any thinning, while Judson sets stout pillars joined by fine thread-like bars. On the page, the sans looks broad beside the serif's finer bars.
gen-gf-judson-gf-lexend-tera: Thick-thin drama up top: Judson swings from heavy stem to hairline, over Lexend Tera's single-weight plain sans letters, spaced like stepping stones. That ratio against a finger-followable outline is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-judson-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta reads wide and rope-like, its tall-bodied small letters spaced out in strokes of constant width. And Judson, with hairlines that squint out of sight in dim light, gives the pairing its bookish side.
gen-gf-judson-gf-montserrat-alternates: Drawn wire meets bent tubing in Judson over Montserrat Alternates. Judson's thick uprights and hairlines contrast with the sans-serif's single gauge, whose open c crowds up toward the capital line.
gen-gf-kablammo-gf-graduate: Kablammo sets a deliberate pace with wide spaces and a very tall x-height, its closed letters standing firm above Graduate. Graduate's open, generous spacing keeps paragraphs dignified and bookish.
